title: Eliminate render-blocking resources
description: Resources are blocking the first paint of your page.
reference_fix: Inline critical CSS and load the remaining stylesheets asynchronously (media=print onload swap or rel=preload as=style); add defer to non-critical scripts.

title: Defer offscreen images
description: Consider lazy-loading offscreen and hidden images.
reference_fix: Add loading="lazy" to below-the-fold tags (but not the LCP image).
